cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Give It Up
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender something they value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. Let me have the medal for the charity auction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the only thing I've ever won.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. Then it should raise more than the toaster.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I lend it for the display? I still want people to know I won.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then present it to the buyer yourself. I'll print your name in the programme; everyone will know whose medal was worth giving up.
